user.title: Bills folder
user.description: The folder OffGrid2Save watches for PDF bills. A relative path starts from your Home Assistant configuration folder. It is created if missing.

sources.title: Energy data sources
sources.description:
Energy counters (kWh) measured by your plant. Victron GX counters are pre-filled when found; any energy sensor with long-term statistics works.

Home consumption is 'sum of' minus 'minus'. If you leave it empty it is derived from production, grid and battery.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.description: Savings come from billing the solar kWh as if the supplier had provided them: the bill's energy cost plus those kWh at the consumption charge, divided by all the kWh of the month, gives a unit cost that values the solar kWh. A manual price replaces all this.

data.price_method: Value of a kWh from the plant
data.tax_rate: VAT rate, used with the variable part when a bill does not show its taxes
data.export_price: What you earn per kWh sold to the grid
data.manual_price: Manual price per kWh, taxes included

source.title: Energy data source
source.description:
Where to read what your plant produced and consumed.

VRM keeps the full history of the plant: when a bill arrives, its days are downloaded from there. Home Assistant sensors need no account, but only cover the days Home Assistant has recorded.

vrm.title: VRM access
vrm.description:
Create an access token on VRM, in Preferences → Integrations → Access tokens, and paste it here. It stays in Home Assistant and is only sent to VRM, and is used to read data.

When changing the configuration, leave it empty to keep the current one.

vrm_site.title: VRM installation
vrm_site.description: This token can read more than one installation: choose yours.

error.path_not_allowed: This folder is not allowed. Use a folder inside the Home Assistant configuration folder, or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.
error.path_not_writable: Home Assistant cannot write to this folder.
error.consumption_or_grid_required: Set the home consumption, or both grid import and solar production.
error.invalid_token: VRM refused this token. Check that you copied it whole.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach VRM. Check the connection and try again.
error.no_installations: This VRM account has no installations.

rescan.name: Check the bills folder
rescan.description: Looks for new PDF bills now instead of waiting for the next check, which happens every 5 minutes.

options.through_plant: The grid feeds the plant (AC-in connected), the plant feeds the home
options.separate: Separate: the plant runs its own loads as an island, the bill pays for the other circuits

options.whole_home: Unit cost over all the kWh of the month, solar included
options.variable: Consumption charge only, leaving out the fixed charges (more cautious)
